title: MZ Looking for a Menu Fade plugin compatible with MZ

posts.author: Noree
posts.body:
Hi! I've been looking for a plugin for a while that would allow me to fade in/out when entering any menu.
Luckily, I found one that does exactly what I'm looking for and that can easily explain what I'm looking for.
Unfortunately, this plugin is only compatible with MV. (I've already checked this in my game made in MZ)
This would be the plugin I'm talking about:
Galv's Menu Fade
If someone could make the plugin compatible with MZ or make a new one that does the same thing but for MZ it would be very helpful!
I read the plugin
creator's terms of use
and saw that he has no problem with the plugin being modified as long as it gives credit and follows the rules!
Thank you in advance for reading my request!

posts.author: utunnels
Noree
posts.body:
utunnels said:
You can save this as a plugin.
(function(alias){Scene_Menu.prototype.createWindowLayer=function(){alias.call(this);this._windowLayer.alpha=0;};})(Scene_Menu.prototype.createWindowLayer);
(function(alias){Scene_Menu.prototype.update=function(){alias.call(this);this._windowLayer.alpha+=0.05;};})(Scene_Menu.prototype.update);
Click to expand...
This works great with objects/content inside windows in the scene, but unfortunately, however, the scene background image still appears without Fade in/out.
I would like the background of the scene to also fade in/out so that everything looks more natural.
